review_notes: I read the whole file. I checked Mathlib's HomogeneousLocalization file (Away.map, awayMap, awayMapAux, which is private) and the Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry/ProjectiveSpectrum files. I found no Mathlib definition of a ring hom out of `Away 𝒜 t` into an arbitrary ring where `f t` is a unit, so `awayMapOfIsUnit` has no existing counterpart to duplicate. It is a thin composite of `IsLocalization.Away.lift` and `algebraMap`. The private `chartSectionMap` is provably equal to a specialisation of `awayMapOfIsUnit` (`chartSectionMap_eq_awayMap`). It is a private helper, though, and the equality costs only one short lemma. That is not clear enough grounds to consolidate, so I abstained. The remaining declarations are lemmas, which the rubric excludes.
